title: Eccentric cylinders: wall pressure around the rotor
caption: Pressure on the rotor between eccentric cylinders, (a) eps = 0.3 and (b) eps = 0.6, against the angle about the rotor axis measured from the narrowest gap in the direction of rotation; mean over the angle removed. Line: Stokes solution of the Newtonian flow (sum of point forces; its wall pressure and wall vorticity integrate to the exact force and torque to 1e-13). Open circles: Newtonian run. Filled symbols: micropolar runs, K = 3, l = 10 dx (m = 5) and l = 25 dx (m = 2), w = 0 on both walls. g = 100 dx, Ma = 0.02, Re = 10 on mu_inf (25 on mu for K = 3). The pressure of a run is the fluid pressure extrapolated to the wall surface (cubic in the wall distance over 0.5 to 12 dx, 72 angle bins, states of the last quarter; every second bin shown). Runs: `nd_e30_newtonian`, `nd_e30_k3_m5`, `nd_e30_k3_m2`, `nd_e60_newtonian`, `nd_e60_k3_m5`, `nd_e60_k3_m2`; Stage 4 and 5 runs without the density diffusion term (numerics.use_density_diffusion: false). eps = 0.3: extremum of the Stokes pressure 0.80 rho U^2, rms difference of the Newtonian run 0.035 rho U^2; micropolar extremum over the Stokes one 1.24, 1.44. eps = 0.6: extremum of the Stokes pressure 2.19 rho U^2, rms difference of the Newtonian run 0.039 rho U^2; micropolar extremum over the Stokes one 1.26, 1.44.
